title: Credit Line Increases and Product Upgrades: Crestline Credit Card Figures
content:
Crestline Credit Card limit increases and product upgrades rest on figures set per product: how long the account must have been open before an increase request, how long after a limit change before another, the largest single increase, and the run of on-time statements that leads to an upgrade review.

| Product | Months open before an increase request | Months after a limit change | Largest single increase | On-time statements before upgrade review | Upgrade product |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Auto Care Card Starter | 9 | 6 | 25% of the current limit | 7 | Crestline Auto Care Card |
| Crestline Auto Care Card | 6 | 6 | 40% | 12 | Crestline Auto Care Card Preferred |
| Crestline Auto Care Card Preferred | 6 | 6 | 50% | 0 (no upgrade path) | none |
| Crestline Auto Care Mastercard | 6 | 6 | 50% | 12 | Crestline Auto Care Mastercard Preferred |
| Crestline Auto Care Mastercard Preferred | 6 | 6 | 50% | 12 | Crestline Auto Care World Mastercard |
| Crestline Auto Care World Mastercard | 6 | 6 | 50% | 0 (no upgrade path) | none |

## Notes

- Months open are calendar months counted from the account's open date.
- The largest single increase is a percentage of the current limit and never takes the limit above the product's highest credit limit.
- A figure of 0 on-time statements means the product has no upgrade path.

Hypothetical reading: a Crestline Auto Care Card with a current limit of 1,000 USD can rise by at most 40%, to 1,400 USD, in one increase.
